        "6": "Slice-Slice the mushrooms",

        "9": "cook-cook for 3-5 minutes, stirring often, until mushrooms start to soften and brown",
        "10": "Pull-Pull out mushroom stems",
        "11": "Heat-Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat",
        "12": "Transfer-Transfer the contents of the pan to a serving dish",
        "13": "Peel-Peel 2 garlic cloves",
        "14": "Add-1/4 tbsp balsamic vinegar to the pan",
        "15": "Add-Add 2 cloves of minced garlic to the pan",
        "16": "Season-pepper on pan to taste",
        "17": "Season-Season pan with salt",
